title: Yesu kotaya pile
stanzas: Yesu kotaya pile, Oritowa mang`uon;An to kabedo bute, Onge gi manyalo luor.Winji, machalo dwonde Malaika mawero, Weche mabiro ira, Weche mamiya mor.
Yesu kotaya pile, Ok anaparora; Piny ok onyalo teroa, Kata richo kethoa;Kata aparo ndalo Ok analuor gimoro;Kata ane masira, Chieng` anamor kucha.
An anadhi ka Yesu, En ma notho kuoma;Pile ageno Yesu, Lwandana mogeng`ona;Piny pod otimo mudho Ka pod awuotho kae; Piny to norum mapiyo, Eka nadhi kucha.
chorus: Yesu kotaya pile, Oritoa mang`won;An to kabedo bute, Onge gi manyalo luor.
